runtimeAdaptations: Only onRequest injection is implemented; no response or SSE rewriting.
Skill frontmatter, slash commands, host-specific mode queries and persistence commands are removed.
Styles are independent booleans using the complete upstream rules; OmniRoute's lite/full/ultra levels, DB, settings API and telemetry backend are not ported.
The [Output Strategy] marker follows OmniRoute's idempotence: an existing marker means already applied and the body is left unchanged.
The per-request autoClarity and media bypass were removed: selected styles inject consistently so the cached system prefix does not change between turns.
Responses instructions are never modified; styles are added as a separate developer input item.
terse-cjk is available explicitly for every locale, instead of only OmniRoute's zh locale.
apply.js retains the original port's marker, catalog composition and request-shape handling, adapted to the cache-stable behavior above.

terse-prose.license: Apache-2.0; earlier MIT contributions retain MIT notice

terse-cjk.note: Chinese text from the full level; the original zh-only locale gate is removed in favor of an explicit user toggle.

apply-design.note: Initial marker, autoClarity and media bypass design was ported here. The latter two per-request gates have been removed to preserve prompt-cache stability.
